FILESTEWARD.Title: File Steward
FILESTEWARD.GMOnly: File Steward is available to Gamemasters only.
FILESTEWARD.Intro: Pick a file to see every scene, token, actor, journal and playlist that uses it, or pick a folder to list the files nothing in this world uses. Relink points everything that uses a file or folder at another one.
FILESTEWARD.NeedTarget: Pick or type a file or folder first.
FILESTEWARD.NeedFolder: Find unused files works on a folder. Pick a folder first.
FILESTEWARD.NoS3: Find unused files does not support S3 storage yet.
FILESTEWARD.BadPath: That doesn't look like a file path.
FILESTEWARD.ListTruncated: Stopped listing at 20,000 files. Pick a smaller folder for a complete report.
FILESTEWARD.UnusedFound: {unused} of {files} files are not used by any of the {scanned} documents in this world.
FILESTEWARD.NoRefs: Nothing in this world references that path.
FILESTEWARD.NoUnused: Every file in this folder is used by this world.
FILESTEWARD.Truncated: Showing {shown} of {total}. Export CSV for the full list.
FILESTEWARD.NoSheet: That document has no sheet to open.

Caveat.World: Only the open world was scanned. Other worlds on this server may use the same files.
Caveat.Packs: {n} world compendium pack(s) were not scanned.
Caveat.Code: Files used only by module or system code, CSS, or hard-coded paths will show as unused. Treat this list as candidates, not proof.

CaseSensitive.Name: Case-sensitive paths
CaseSensitive.Hint: Leave on for Linux servers, where Map.webp and map.webp are different files. Turn off for Windows or macOS hosts.

Menu.Name: File Steward
Menu.Label: Open File Steward
Menu.Hint: Find where a file is used, or list unused files in a folder.

SidecarToken.Name: Server helper token
SidecarToken.Hint: From the sidecar installer's output. Stored only in this browser; players never receive it.

SidecarUrl.Name: Server helper URL
SidecarUrl.Hint: Leave empty to use this server's /file-steward/api route. Stored only in this browser.

Keybinding.Name: Open File Steward
Keybinding.Hint: Opens the File Steward window (GM only).

FILESTEWARD.RelinkHint: Point everything that uses this file or folder at another file or folder. Shows a preview first, and can be undone.
FILESTEWARD.RelinkNeedTarget: Pick the file or folder whose references you want to move first.
FILESTEWARD.SameTarget: The destination is the same as the source.
FILESTEWARD.RelinkSkipped: {n} reference(s) will be skipped because the destination file doesn't exist or the stored path couldn't be matched safely. They are listed after the run.
FILESTEWARD.RelinkSafe: Only the file paths change. Scene sizes, walls and lights are untouched, and you can undo this afterwards.
FILESTEWARD.RelinkNothing: Nothing was changed: {missing} reference(s) point at files that don't exist at the destination, and {failed} couldn't be matched safely.
FILESTEWARD.RelinkRemaining: {n} reference(s) still point at the old path. See the notes below.
FILESTEWARD.Failed: {label}: skipped, stored path couldn't be matched safely ({raw})
FILESTEWARD.TwinsFound: {n} unused file(s) have a twin in use (same name, different type).
FILESTEWARD.UseThisHint: Point everything that uses {name} at this file instead.
FILESTEWARD.UndoConflicts: {n} field(s) were edited after the relink and were left alone.

Skip.NoDocument: stored outside documents (for example the world background); change it in the world's configuration
Skip.Unchanged: value no longer matches; left alone
Skip.ChangedSince: changed since the relink; left alone

FILESTEWARD.RelinkAllTwinsHint: Point everything using a .png or .jpg at its .webp twin. Smaller files, same picture; you'll see a preview first.
FILESTEWARD.MoveHint: Move or rename this file or folder on the server, and update everything that uses it.
FILESTEWARD.MovePrompt: New path (change the folder, the name, or both):
FILESTEWARD.MoveConfirm: {refs} {refWord} in {docs} {docWord} will be updated to the new path.
FILESTEWARD.MoveSafe: The file is copied first and references are updated. The original goes to trash only if nothing still points at it. You can undo this.
FILESTEWARD.MoveDone: Moved to {to}; {applied} {refWord} updated. The original is in the trash.
FILESTEWARD.MoveKept: Copied and relinked, but {n} reference(s) still point at the original, so it was kept. See the notes below.
FILESTEWARD.TrashConfirm: Move {n} item(s) to the File Steward trash?
FILESTEWARD.TrashSafe: Trash keeps them outside Foundry's Data folder until you empty it. You can restore them.
FILESTEWARD.NowInUse: {n} file(s) became used since the report and were left alone:
FILESTEWARD.StillUsed: This is still used by {refs} {refWord} in {docs} {docWord}:
FILESTEWARD.StillUsedWarn: Trashing it will break those references until you restore it.
FILESTEWARD.TrashKept: Items stay until you empty the trash.
FILESTEWARD.TrashRetention: Items are purged automatically after {n} days.
FILESTEWARD.PurgeWarn: This permanently deletes the files from the server. It can't be undone.
FILESTEWARD.PurgeAllConfirm: Permanently delete all {n} item(s) in the trash?

Sidecar.Ok: Server helper connected (v{version}): move, rename and trash are on.
Sidecar.no-token: Server helper not set up: move and delete are off. See the README to install it.
Sidecar.unauthorized: Server helper found, but the token was rejected. Check the token in settings.
Sidecar.unreachable: Server helper not reachable. Check the URL setting and your proxy route.
Sidecar.incompatible: Server helper version doesn't match this module. Update both.
Sidecar.Recheck: Click to check the connection again
Sidecar.NeededForUndo: Undoing this needs the server helper, which isn't connected right now.

FILESTEWARD.SelectHint: Tick files to act on several at once (Shift-click selects a range).
FILESTEWARD.PreviewFailed: Couldn't play that file in the browser.
FILESTEWARD.UploadHint: Add files to the chosen folder. You can also drag files from your computer onto this window.
FILESTEWARD.NeedUploadFolder: Pick the folder to upload into first (Folder button).
FILESTEWARD.NoS3Upload: Uploading into S3 storage isn't supported yet. Use Foundry's file picker for S3.
FILESTEWARD.UploadExists: {n} file(s) with the same name are already in this folder:
FILESTEWARD.UploadReplaceWarn: Replacing overwrites the old file for good. Scenes and playlists that use it will show the new file.

UploadSkip.type: this file type can't be uploaded to Foundry
UploadSkip.duplicate: the same name was picked twice
